messages:
Sofia (CS): Quick sync 10am PT1 1 CypressData returned their security questionnaire. Main asks: SOC2 excerpt, DPA retention specifics for embeddings, and explicit support for customer-managed keys (BYOK) for embeddings and model KV caches. Renewal in ~5 weeks, they want answers and a contract path.
Priya (Security): I can draft the SOC2 + KMS response. TL;DR: we publish a redacted SOC2 Type II, we offer BYOK/HSM for Private deployments with signed addendum, and Dedicated can integrate with customer KMS in approved regions but BYOK as a contract add-on. I'll list the evidence they'd likely ask for. :lock:
Daniel (Eng): Tech nuance: for Hosted we use platform-managed key wrapping; for Private we can wire to customer KMS/HSM. Embeddings path also depends on storage option (S3 vs local). Sample config we usually share:
```
storage:
  embeddings:
    backend: s3
    bucket: "customer-embeddings-prod"
kms:
  mode: byok
  provider: aws-cloudhsm
  wrap_alg: aes-gcm
  allowed_regions: ["us-west-2","eu-central-1"]
```
Evan (AE): Renewal risk: medium-high until we confirm BYOK + SOW/PO. Can Legal fast-track the BYOK addendum if CS gets PO today? Customer indicated they want a legal-ready addendum within 7 days.
Lina (Legal): We have a BYOK addendum template but we require a PO or SOW and the named signatory. If CS can secure the PO we can do a 48h initial review and flag any non-starters. DPA retention changes (they want 60 days for embeddings) are negotiable but may need compliance sign-off.
Sofia (CS): I'll ask CypressData for PO and signatory this morning and propose a 30-min technical + contract call next Tue 9am PT. Priya, can you prepare a one-page SOC2 + evidence checklist? Daniel, please prep a short technical slide showing Hosted vs Private embeddings and KMS flows.
onboard-bot: checklist updated - "vendor questionnaire: SOC2 evidence requested" checked by Priya (Security)
Priya (Security): Put together a one-pager gist: https://gist.github.com/priya/cypress-soc2-kms (contains: redacted report link, control owners, log retention screenshots, KMS integration checklist).
Daniel (Eng): I'll add a config snippet and a tiny demo of the encrypted embeddings write path. Also call out region availability: eu-central-1 currently for Dedicated; ap-southeast planned in 6 weeks (might affect their residency ask).
Evan (AE): I'll draft the customer email requesting PO + preferred call times and template SOW checklist. Will include renewal impact note.
Sofia (CS): Action items: 1) Sofia to request PO + signatory (by EOD); 2) Priya to share SOC2 one-pager and artifact list; 3) Daniel to prep tech slide + demo; 4) Lina to queue BYOK addendum review once PO arrives. We'll update the questionnaire portal after the call. :white_check_mark:
Lina (Legal): Noted. If PO arrives, Ill aim to return redlines within 48h and flag any unusual cryptographic language.
Sofia (CS): Thanks team. I'll post the calendar invite tentatively for Tue 9am PT and update when Cypress confirms. Closing loop on this thread for now. :thumbsup:
